title: payment-setup LinkedRecord payload
description: The rate, keyed to a Definition. Linked by reference, never embedded: a definition is complete and usable with no rate attached, because recognition is a use of its own (§7).

amountMinor.description: Minor units. Money is never a float.

authoredByPartyId.description: Who priced this version (F-1). The author prices a unit somebody else defined; they never redefine it — a rate record cannot touch the definition it is keyed to. Optional because a rate attached by seeding or an earlier deployment has no recorded author, and inventing one would be a lie.

supersedesVersion.description: The LinkedRecord version this one replaces. A rate is terms, not a setting: published, named, never edited underneath anyone — a change is a new version that names what it supersedes, and payments read the version in force at the relevant time.
